newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan tankan backs firm recovery view - BOJ quoted.
newsitem.headline: Japan tankan backs firm recovery view - BOJ quoted.

text.p: Bank of Japan Governor Yasuo Matsushita was quoted as telling cabinet ministers on Tuesday that the central bank's recent "tankan" business survey backed its view that Japan's economic recovery was firming.

Matsushita made the remarks at a meeting of economic ministers, a government official said. The governor said short-term interest rates had been moving stably at levels slightly below the 0.5 percent official discount rate.
Long-term interest rates renewed all-time low levels at the beginning of December.
